title: Adding a top-level key or a bound enum member reds two-way skill gates in both card orders under the skills split
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① tooling/rules defect with a named producer, raised outside the diff by contract review 6816730756 on PR #32581 (#32549). It is the addition-side twin of #32550. ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade, and whether it needs a decision card.

## The case

A product-lane PR that ADDS an authorable `defineStack()` top-level key, or a live member of a schema symbol bound to a registered exhaustive skills section, meets a two-way gate:

- `scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs`: the symmetric difference against the skills enumeration. The new key with no skills row is red `[missing]` in the product PR. A skills PR that lists it first is red `[phantom]`.
- `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` Leg 2: a new live member with no row is red `[leg2-missing-row]` in the product PR.

`lanes/skills.md` L13-14 on `main`: a product-lane PR never edits `skills/**`, and the skills sub-card is `Blocked-by:` the product card. Both gates run on every PR with no paths filter (`lint.yml`). Under the split the product PR is red with no legal repair, and the reversed order is red too. PR #32581 binds the lane's reversed order to removals only, so it does not answer this case.

## Reach

The next product PR that adds a top-level key, or a member to a bound enum, that a published skill enumerates.

## Duplicate check

#32550 is the removal-side `generate-kinds` case. No open card names the addition case.
